title: 第一卷 正文第19章 叶飞宇第一卷 正文第20章 学宫规矩
content_zh:
楚凌天看都没看苏媚一眼，直接掠过她，寻找自己的宿舍。
作为楚家分支曾经的第一天才，在经历过楚山的歹毒手段之后，楚凌天的心智已经变得十分成熟。
他一眼就看出来，苏媚心怀鬼胎，所以才不予理会。
“本小姐还就不信了，那么多家族子弟都拜倒在了本小姐的石榴裙下，你一个雏儿，能逃得出本小姐的手掌心？”苏媚看着楚凌天冷漠的背影，咬了咬嘴唇，眼底掠过一抹阴冷。
正如楚凌天猜想的那样，苏媚故意接近他，是有目的的。
学宫考核结束后，楚山便去了苏家，与苏家家主达成了交易。
只要苏媚在星辰学宫中除掉楚凌天，楚山就会付给苏家一笔巨额报酬。
按照苏媚的想法，楚凌天一个雏儿，自己随便勾勾手，不就是上套了？但没想到，楚凌天竟然坐怀不乱，她只能另寻他法。
……
星辰学宫依山而建，面积广阔。楚凌天等人居住的地方说是叫宿舍，其实是一个个独立的小院子。
院子的门牌上，刻着房号。
楚凌天来到三百六十六号院子门口，拿出铁钥匙，打开门上的大铁锁，推门而入。
院子并不大，只有一百个平方，院内也只有一间房子，布置十分简单。
但楚凌天对此已十分满意。
他们毕竟只是刚入门的新生，能有的这样的居住条件，已经很不错了。
楚凌天稍微打扫了一下院子。就在他归置东西时，门外突然响起了粗暴地砸门声。
楚凌天眉头一皱：“请进。”
一名身穿锦衣、满脸嚣张的男子，迈步而入。他的身后还跟着两名狗腿子。
“你就是风云城楚家分支的楚凌天？”锦衣男子态度高傲地问道。
“是我。”楚凌天眼中掠过一抹疑惑，”你是？”

一名狗腿子昂起头，用鼻孔对着楚凌天：“叶少乃是流云郡三大家族之一，叶家的嫡系子弟叶飞宇。”
叶家与楚家同属流云郡三大家族。只不过，楚家乃是三大家族之首，实力要比叶家强上不少。
“你有事？”楚凌天冷漠道。
叶飞宇眉头皱起，脸上露出一抹不悦。
他本以为楚凌天听到自己的身份，会像身后的两名狗腿子一样，对自己毕恭毕敬、点头哈腰。
毕竟他是叶家的嫡系子弟，即便在郡城内，都是有名的公子哥。而楚凌天不过来自于偏远的风云城罢了。
“怎么跟叶少说话呢！”那名狗腿子冷喝道，“叶少来此，是看你也出自流云郡，给你一个追随他的机会。你一个没有血脉的废物，若没有叶少的庇护，必定在星辰学宫内寸步难行！”
叶家作为流云郡三大家族之一，势力强大。学宫考核一结束，叶家就已掌握了流云郡内，所有通过考核，加入学宫的人的大概信息。
这样做的目的，就是为了叶家子弟进入学宫后，可以为叶家收服、拉拢有潜力的人。
content_en:
Chu Lingtian didn't even glance at Su Mei, and just passed her, looking for his dormitory.
As the former number one genius of the Chu family branch, Chu Lingtian's mind has become very mature after experiencing Chu Shan's vicious methods.
He could tell at a glance that Su Mei had evil intentions, so he ignored her.
"I still don't believe it. So many children from the family have fallen under my pomegranate skirt. How can you, a young child, escape from the palm of my hand?" Su Mei looked at Chu Lingtian's indifferent back and bit her lip. A coldness flashed across her eyes.
Just as Chu Lingtian suspected, Su Mei deliberately approached him for a purpose.
After the academy examination, Chu Shan went to the Su family and reached a deal with the head of the Su family.
As long as Su Mei gets rid of Chu Lingtian in Xingchen Academy, Chushan will pay the Su family a huge reward.
According to Su Mei's thinking, if Chu Lingtian is just a young boy, and he flirts with her casually, isn't that just a trap? But she didn't expect that Chu Lingtian would remain calm, so she could only find another way.
…
Xingchen Academy is built on the mountain and has a vast area. The place where Chu Lingtian and others live is called a dormitory, but it is actually a small independent courtyard.
The house number is engraved on the house number in the courtyard.
Chu Lingtian came to the door of courtyard No. 366, took out the iron key, opened the big iron lock on the door, and pushed the door open.
The courtyard is not big, only one hundred square meters, and there is only one house in the courtyard. The layout is very simple.
But Chu Lingtian was very satisfied with this.
After all, they are just freshmen, and the living conditions they can have are already very good.
Chu Lingtian cleaned the yard a little. Just as he was putting things away, there was suddenly a violent banging on the door.
Chu Lingtian frowned: "Please come in."
A man wearing brocade clothes and an arrogant face stepped in. Behind him were two henchmen.
"Are you Chu Lingtian from the Chu family branch in Fengyun City?" the man in brocade clothes asked arrogantly.
"It's me." Chu Lingtian's eyes flashed with confusion, "Who are you?"
A bastard raised his head and pointed his nostrils at Chu Lingtian: "Ye Shaonai is one of the three major families in Liuyun County. He is a direct descendant of Ye Feiyu."
The Ye family and the Chu family both belong to the three major families in Liuyun County. However, the Chu family is the head of the three major families and is much stronger than the Ye family.
"What's wrong with you?" Chu Lingtian said coldly.
Ye Feiyu frowned, with a hint of displeasure on his face.
He originally thought that when Chu Lingtian heard about his identity, he would treat him with respect, nod and bow like the two henchmen behind him.
After all, he is a direct descendant of the Ye family, and he is a famous son even in the county. And Chu Lingtian just came from the remote Fengyun City.
"Why are you talking to Young Master Ye!" The loser shouted coldly, "Young Master Ye is here to see that you are from Liuyun County and to give you a chance to follow him. You are a waste without blood. Without Young Master Ye's protection, you will definitely be unable to move in the Star Academy!"
As one of the three major families in Liuyun County, the Ye family is powerful. As soon as the academy examination was over, the Ye family already had general information about all the people in Liuyun County who had passed the examination and joined the academy.
The purpose of doing this is so that after the children of the Ye family enter the academy, they can win over and win over potential people for the Ye family.
